description: Presidential Secretariat - Dissolve the Parliament with effect from midnight on 26.06.2015 and summon the new Parliament to meet on the first day of September 2015
categorisation: This gazette content is a presidential proclamation that dissolves Parliament, sets the date for parliamentary elections, specifies the nomination period, and designates nomination places for electoral districts. It deals exclusively with electoral processes and scheduling, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) as it contains election announcements, schedules, and nomination procedures.
